answer.reason: The verses tell two chief deeds of Ehud: killing King Eglon and leading Israel against Moab.

clauses.english: killed Eglon king of Moab with a dagger in his summer parlour
clauses.quote: took the dagger from his right thigh, and thrust it into his belly

clauses.english: led Israel to take the fords of Jordan and defeat Moab
clauses.quote: they slew of Moab at that time about ten thousand men
